"We have concluded most of the discussions and are fine-tuning the agreement," he said here while talking about the India-U.S. trade agreement. India-U.S. deal ‘finalised’, implementation after clarity on India’s competitive advantage, says Goyal India-U.S. deal ‘finalised’, implementation after clarity on India’s competitive advantage, says Goyal Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said that the deal was going through its final contours and the legal drafting.
